meta.title: Credit meter
meta.description: Shows the remaining DeepSeek account credit in the reading row under the composer: a wallet glyph, the word Balance, and the spendable amounts. Same-currency top-up and bonus balances are added together; each funded currency is listed separately in a fixed order (CNY, then USD), with no currency conversion and no cross-currency sum. A funded amount below one cent stays visible as <¥0.01, and an all-zero or wallet-less response shows one zero reading (¥ when CNY was returned or no wallet was, $ when only USD was). Hover it for the amount under its full label (Available Balance) followed by the non-zero top-up and bonus balances in the same order. It re-reads when a turn settles, once a minute while the window is visible, and when the window regains focus, so the amount follows what the session spends. Nothing is shown while signed out or before the first read; a failed read keeps the last value and marks it stale. The reading is account-wide, so switching sessions does not change it; a blank home screen has no reading row and shows nothing. Turning the plugin off removes the reading and its balance queries.
